notes.subject: כארי
notes.rationale: Ketiv 'like a lion' (JPS: at my hands and feet) vs qere/ancient versions 'they pierced' (ka'aru); I kept the written consonants' lion image.

notes.subject: ye
notes.rationale: Bamanankan needs the copula/verb 'ye' where Hebrew leaves כארי ידי ורגלי as a bare comparison phrase.

notes.subject: סבבוני/הקיפוני
notes.rationale: Paired near-synonyms 'surround me / enclose me' frame the verse; the doubling is kept with wiri / sɔrɔ tiɲɛnama.

translation: Sabu wanw ye n wiri, mɔgɔ juguw ka jama ye n sɔrɔ tiɲɛnama; i n'a fɔ waraba ⟨ye⟩, n bolow ni n senw.
